description:
Cleanup gap from the tractable switch (#4013, merged 2026-11-07). On 2026-11-14, 42 BenchBox.wt-* worktrees were on branches cut before #4013. Their .mcp.json registers todo-db through each worktree's own pinned todo-db wheel, and their copy of the todo skill tells agents to run bare todo-db CLI commands, which fail since the global todo-db was uninstalled on 2026-11-11. Worktrees pinned to todo-db 0.9.1-0.13.0 also get E_SCHEMA from their own server: schema 4 arrived in 0.14.0 and older clients refuse a schema-4 store, so they have no working tracker at all. Those on 0.14.0 or 0.15.0 work but follow older claim rules.

Census 2026-11-14 (dirty = uncommitted changes; unpushed = commits not on origin): 29 clean (dirty 0, unpushed 0), 13 with local work.

Decision (owner, 2026-11-14): remove the 29 clean worktrees with BenchBox's worktree tooling, keeping their branches; leave the 13 with local work and list them in this item for the owner.

Guardrails:
- Never remove a worktree with uncommitted changes or commits that are not on origin; recheck both immediately before each removal.
- Keep every branch.
- Use the repository's worktree tooling (make worktree-finish or worktree-reap, with the expected head). Fall back to plain `git worktree remove` (never --force) only when the tooling refuses a clean worktree for provenance reasons, and record that.
- Never patch .mcp.json in place; never force-push; no change to any branch or PR.
